verdict.rationale: First-party docs support a self-serve path: a free CRM with no expiration lets a founder sign up without a sales or partner process, multi-object import brings in deals, companies and activities with associations, self-service transfer moves data from an existing CRM, automatic deduplication cleans imported records, and inbox connection and pre-built sales reports make the pipeline usable. Nothing in the evidence backs the 'under an hour' time bound or shows how a deal pipeline and its stages are configured. Missing for 10: evidence of time-to-value within an hour, documentation of deal pipeline and stage setup, independent or hands-on corroboration that a founder can complete onboarding unassisted.
